cards.what_to_check: Check level on dipstick — must be in safe operating range (between low and full marks). No leaks at oil pan, valve cover.
cards.why: Low oil leads to engine damage; leaks indicate seal/gasket failure.

cards.what_to_check: Coolant in reservoir at proper level. Hoses secure, no cracks, leaks, or bulges. Radiator no leaks.
cards.why: Low coolant or compromised hoses cause overheating and engine failure.

cards.what_to_check: Fluid at proper level. No leaks at pump, hoses, or steering box. Belt tight, not cracked or frayed.
cards.why: Loss of power steering can cause loss of vehicle control.

cards.what_to_check: Belts properly tight (no more than ~3/4 inch play), not cracked, frayed, slipping, or glazed. Pulleys aligned.
cards.why: Broken belt loses charging, water pump, power steering — all critical.

cards.what_to_check: Steering box securely mounted, no missing/loose bolts. Hoses no cracks, leaks. Sector shaft seal not leaking.
cards.why: Steering failure = loss of control.

cards.what_to_check: Tread depth at least 4/32 inch in every major groove on every front (steer) tire. No cuts/damage exposing fabric or steel cord. Tires properly inflated, valve stem and cap intact, no separations between tire and rim.
cards.why: Federal and state rules require ≥4/32 on steer; failure can cause blowout. Other tires only need 2/32.

cards.what_to_check: Rim not bent, cracked, or damaged. No welding repairs (illegal on rims). No missing/broken/loose lug nuts. No rust trails around lugs (sign of looseness).
cards.why: A failed rim or lost wheel = catastrophic. Rust trails = loose lugs.

cards.what_to_check: Hub seal not leaking. Oil level visible in sight glass and at proper level.
cards.why: Loss of hub oil destroys wheel bearings and can lock up the wheel.

cards.what_to_check: Securely mounted. No cracks or dents. Hoses connected, no leaks or audible air leaks.
cards.why: Cracked chamber = loss of brake on that wheel.

cards.what_to_check: Pushrod travel less than 1 inch with brakes applied. Slack adjuster not bent, properly aligned. Pin/clevis secure.
cards.why: Out-of-adjustment brakes = legal out-of-service violation and stopping distance increase.

cards.what_to_check: Drum no cracks, no contamination from oil/grease. Linings ≥1/4 inch thick (drum brakes), not contaminated.
cards.why: Cracked drum can fail explosively under heat; contaminated linings won't grip.

cards.what_to_check: Tie rod ends secure (cotter pin/castle nut). No looseness in kingpin. All steering linkage tight, no missing bolts.
cards.why: Steering linkage failure = total loss of steering.

cards.what_to_check: Leaf springs no cracks/broken/missing leaves. U-bolts tight, not broken. Shock absorbers no leaks. Mounts secure.
cards.why: Broken spring or U-bolt can cause axle to shift — catastrophic handling failure.

cards.what_to_check: Mounted securely, no leaks. Cap on tight. Straps not damaged. No dents that affect capacity.
cards.why: Loose fuel tank = fire hazard; missing cap = fuel loss / contamination.

cards.what_to_check: No cracks, no missing/loose bolts at U-joints. Slip joint not damaged. Carrier bearing (if present) secure.
cards.why: Failed U-joint at speed can punch through cab or bind drive train.

cards.what_to_check: Mounted securely. No leaks (look for soot, cracks). DPF/DEF system intact (modern trucks). No contact with electrical wiring or fuel lines.
cards.why: Exhaust leaks send CO into cab; ignites fuel/wires.

cards.what_to_check: No cracks, bends, or missing/broken cross members. No unauthorized welds. Mounting brackets secure.
cards.why: Frame damage compromises load-bearing — vehicle out of service.

cards.what_to_check: Tread depth ≥2/32 inch in every major groove. Dual tires same size, same type, evenly inflated, not touching each other or frame.
cards.why: Mismatched duals = uneven wear and failure under load.

cards.what_to_check: Spacers (if present) not bent, secure. All lug nuts present, no rust trails, evenly tight.
cards.why: Loose lugs cause wheel separation.

cards.what_to_check: Service lines (blue), emergency/supply lines (red) — secure, no cracks, no leaks. Glad hands sealed when connected.
cards.why: Air loss = brake failure; cross-connection causes brake malfunction.

cards.what_to_check: Mounted securely to frame, no cracks/missing bolts. Locking jaws fully closed and locked around kingpin. Release handle in locked position. Safety latch engaged. Properly lubricated.
cards.why: Improper coupling = trailer separation. Most catastrophic failure mode.

cards.what_to_check: Kingpin not bent, no excess wear. Apron flat against fifth wheel — no gap. No space between trailer apron and fifth wheel skid plate.
cards.why: Gap means uncoupled or mis-coupled — trailer can come off.

cards.what_to_check: Lines secure, not damaged, no leaks. Glad hands properly connected (red to emergency, blue to service). 7-pin electrical secure.
cards.why: Disconnected lines = no trailer brakes or lights.

cards.what_to_check: Fully raised, crank handle secured. No damage. Both legs even.
cards.why: Landing gear extended at speed = catastrophic damage.

cards.what_to_check: Tail, brake, turn, marker lights all working. Reflectors clean, not broken or missing. License plate light works, plate secure.
cards.why: Lighting violations are common automatic-fail items.

cards.what_to_check: Present, securely mounted, not torn. Cover full width of tire.
cards.why: Required by law on rear of tractors and trailers.

cards.what_to_check: Same as tractor: chambers secure, slack adjuster pushrod travel <1 inch, drums no cracks, linings ≥1/4 inch.
cards.why: Trailer brakes do most of the work on combinations.

cards.what_to_check: Present (post-1998 trailers required), no cracks, securely mounted, ≤22 inches above ground, full width.
cards.why: Required to prevent vehicle underride in rear collisions.

cards.what_to_check: Both side mirrors clean, properly adjusted, no cracks. Convex (spot) mirrors present and aligned.
cards.why: Cannot pass test without proper rearward visibility.

cards.what_to_check: Windshield no cracks in driver's view. Wipers function on all speeds, blades not torn. Washer fluid sprays.
cards.why: Clear forward vision required by law.

cards.what_to_check: ≤10 degrees free play (about 2 inches at rim of 20-inch wheel).
cards.why: Excess play means worn steering — out-of-service item.

cards.what_to_check: Air horn AND electric horn both function (if equipped).
cards.why: Required for emergency signaling.

cards.what_to_check: Defroster blows on windshield. Heater functions (required especially in cold weather).
cards.why: Required to maintain forward visibility.

cards.what_to_check: 3 reflective triangles, fire extinguisher (charged, secured, properly rated), spare electrical fuses (unless circuit breakers).
cards.why: FMCSR §393.95 — required emergency equipment.

cards.what_to_check: Mounted securely, no cuts/frays, latch works.
cards.why: Required for examiner-driver pair during road test.

cards.what_to_check: With engine off, full air pressure, brakes released: ≤2 psi/min loss (single) or ≤3 psi/min (combination). With brakes applied: ≤3 psi/min (single) or ≤4 psi/min (combination).
cards.why: Excessive leakage = unsafe air system.

cards.what_to_check: With engine off, fan brakes to drop pressure. Low air warning (light/buzzer) must activate before pressure drops to 60 psi.
cards.why: Required warning before brake failure.

cards.what_to_check: Continue fanning brakes — at 20-45 psi, parking/emergency brake valve should pop out automatically (apply spring brakes).
cards.why: Failsafe so vehicle can't be driven with no air.

cards.what_to_check: From 85 to 100 psi in 45 seconds at engine governed RPM (in dual systems).
cards.why: Slow build-up = compressor problem; brakes won't recharge fast enough.

cards.what_to_check: Compressor governor cuts out between 120-140 psi. Engine speed to governed RPM, watch dash gauge.
cards.why: Governor regulates max system pressure.

cards.what_to_check: Roll forward at ~5 mph, apply service brakes firmly. Vehicle must not pull to either side, no unusual feel.
cards.why: Confirms brakes work and apply evenly.
